title: 9.4 The Tangent Ratio

icans: I can find the tangent of an acute angle in a right triangle.
I can use tangent to find a missing leg of a right triangle.
I can use an angle of elevation to solve real-life problems.

vocab: a ratio of the lengths of two sides of a right ___________
the angle from the _____________ up to your line of sight

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: same angle, same ratio

blocks.p: Draw a right triangle with a 35° angle. Use the adjacent leg your teacher gives you. Measure the opposite leg.
tan 35° on the calculator: ______  What do you notice?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem: Find tan A and tan B. Write each as a fraction and as a decimal rounded to four places.

notes: Same angle, same ratio: the tangent of an angle is the same in every _______________ right triangle, no matter how big.

blocks.stem: Use a calculator to find tan 52° and tan 38°. Round to four places. What do you notice?

notes: Finding a leg: write tan = opposite ÷ adjacent, put in what you know, and _______________ for x. Keep the calculator in _______________ mode.

blocks.stem: Find the value of x. Round to the nearest tenth.
Find the value of x. Round to the nearest tenth.

notes: Angle of elevation: the angle from the _______________ up to your line of sight.

blocks.stem: You stand 40 feet from the base of a tree. The angle of elevation from the ground to the top of the tree is 58°. How tall is the tree? Round to the nearest tenth.
A right triangle has legs of 7 and 24 and a hypotenuse of 25. ∠A is across from the leg of 7. Find tan A and tan B as fractions and decimals.
Find the value of x. Round to the nearest tenth.

tickets.stem: In right △ABC, the leg opposite ∠A is 12 and the leg adjacent to ∠A is 5. Find tan A.
In a right triangle, one acute angle is 40° and the leg adjacent to it is 9. Find the leg opposite the 40° angle. Round to the nearest tenth.
From 30 feet away, the angle of elevation to the top of a building is 35°. How tall is the building? Round to the nearest tenth.
